description: This file contains the implementation of the ReprocessLoanTransactionsService interface, providing methods for reprocessing, updating, and managing loan transactions within a loan management system. It handles transaction reprocessing, applying business logic for loan transaction adjustments, and publishing business events related to loan transactions.

classes.name: ReprocessLoanTransactionsServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class that handles reprocessing, updating, and managing loan transactions, including business event notification and accounting journal posting.

methods.name: reprocessTransactions
methods.description: Reprocess all non-reversed loan transactions post-disbursement for a given loan and handle the resulting changed transaction details.

methods.name: reprocessParticularTransactions
methods.description: Reprocess a specific list of loan transactions for a given loan and handle updates accordingly.

methods.name: reprocessTransactionsWithPostTransactionChecks
methods.description: Reprocess non-reversed transactions with additional post-transaction checks, identified by transaction date.

methods.name: processPostDisbursementTransactions
methods.description: Process and reprocess post-disbursement transactions for a loan.

methods.name: removeLoanCharge
methods.description: Remove (deactivate) a specific loan charge and reprocess transactions if applicable.

methods.name: removeOrModifyTransactionAssociatedWithLoanCharge
methods.description: Adjust loan transactions if they are associated with a loan charge that is due at disbursement.

methods.name: doesLoanChargePaidByContainLoanCharge
methods.description: Check if a set of LoanChargePaidBy objects contains a specific LoanCharge.

methods.name: processLatestTransaction
methods.description: Reprocess the latest transaction for a loan, with specialized logic for advanced payment schedules.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Update the interest schedule model, reprocessing transactions if no saved model exists.

methods.name: handleChangedDetail
methods.description: Handle processing of changed transactions, including journal posting and event notification.

methods.name: reprocessTransactionsAndFetchChangedTransactions
methods.description: Reprocess a list of transactions and update the loan with new transactions; also recalculate relevant schedules and balances.
